name: Cy
self_text: Hi! I'm Cy, a non-binary Australian in my late 20s. When I'm not out with my Leica, I spend a lot of my time podcasting, which I love because it lets me explore so many different stories. I'm looking for a practice session where we can work on specific shots together. Regarding the editing side of things, I am happy to teach post-processing. I am also fine with not taking portraits of each other during our time. I'm free Sunday morning if that works for you!

requests.request_text: I need you to be into a practice session working on specific shots or a relaxed photo walk. Ideally, you are the one who learns post-processing from me, but no big deal.
